check.r13_source_baseline.scope: Round 13 (Codex review 27/10 on f71ba51, P1 content preservation) through the real engine.step + artifact API + engine.verify with the candidate Git tree inspected: the out-of-scope comparison uses ONE baseline — the source capture the ENGINE takes when it admits the attempt (node.started.source: HEAD plus working bytes, uncommitted edits, new files and deletions included) overlaid with outputs of producers the engine recorded and that are still current — never HEAD, the current working tree or producers as alternatives, never the candidate's own parent chain. check.r12_package_identity.scope: Round 12 (Codex review 27/10, P2-D): every gate receipt of a handover package must be readable JSON carrying the gate commit AND the gate wheel sha256 (and a wheel_used naming only that wheel when present); a missing field, invalid JSON, an unreadable receipt, a receipt of another run, a missing required receipt (required set = registry snapshot x decision.releases, size-checked against implementation_checks) is refused by the same function (package_check.receipt_problems) before build (build_package.check_one_build) and in the shipped identity step (package_scope); the identity comes from manifest/build.json, never from the receipt; a package whose SHA256SUMS is valid but whose receipt identities contradict is refused by identity while the checksum step passes; a consistent evidence set passes; refused/blocked bundle results stay packaged and pass. Also the release_bootstrap INPUTS sentence is tested by behaviour on a built package.

check.r12_pl_local_rules.scope: Round 12 (Codex review 27/10, WKPL C-class): local rules for T45e E19, E20 and E27 on synthetic fixtures only, enforced at the pipeline entry points. finalgate.decide (KQ2) judges the bundle's acceptance_report (AC1-AC3 'chỉ bộ kiểm, chưa có việc thật trên B', R06-R08 'chỉ bộ kiểm, chưa dùng thật', SKIP leak 'không có dữ liệu'; no 'đạt' or real-use claim without an owner-chosen U3 real pilot receipt on B), its rerun row, its comparison.records (per item: affected flag, basis, A/B hash pair) and its record_files layout (three kinds in three files, no kind-1 edit). A real-mode bundle must supply all four. pilot_report.check_report requires an aggregate that names a final_artifact to carry a rerun_on_final row labelled 'kiểm báo cáo' with no behaviour column and never behaviour evidence, rendered in the Markdown. pilot_tools verify --final-commit/--final-wheel-sha256 emits that row and refuses a regenerated report without it. Proves rules only; no real A->B comparison, no real PL-B ledger, no pilot evidence.

check.r13_bundle_receipts.scope: Round 13 (Codex review 27/10, P2 bundle evidence chain): every receipt under bundles/<R>/receipts/ that bundle.json declares (installed, upgrade, events, rollback, notes) or that those receipts reference by hash (rollback old/forward runs, notes.real_checks, gate_history, comparison originals) must exist, be readable JSON, match its declared sha256 and carry the identity of the build its ROLE names: current-build receipts the manifest commit and wheel, previous-build receipts (rollback-old-run, upgrade.from, events.old_artifact, old scan version) the pinned previous build (manifest.previous_wheel, or first_release.baseline == release-check first_release_baseline == manifest for a first release); a missing/unreadable/unhashed receipt, a wrong hash, a receipt no declaration reaches, a receipt of another release/kind, a current-role receipt with the previous identity (and vice versa), or a previous build nobody pins is refused naming the file, by the same package_check.bundle_receipt_problems before build (check_one_build) and in the shipped identity step (package_scope); a valid SHA256SUMS is byte integrity only; refused/blocked bundles (produced:false) keep their evidence and pass. Verified on temp copies of the real f71ba51 package; the untouched real packages pass. Round 13b: every (path, sha256) reference in the chain is judged on its own against the file's bytes, whatever its position or how many times the file is named (two references to one file with different sha256 can never both hold; the wrong one is named by its site: notes.json real_checks[i], bundle.json gate_history[i] / comparison.items[i].original / checks.<x>, rollback.json forward_run / allowed.old_run); a malformed or outside-the-bundle real_checks entry is refused for a produced bundle, never skipped; consistent repeated references and history files outside receipts/ (hash + readability only) pass; refused bundles keep bundle-result.json and their remaining contradictions are still named. Round 13c (Codex review 28/10 on dev16): every container the chain reads has a fixed JSON type (lists: notes.real_checks, bundle.json gate_history / comparison.items / deliveries, installed scenarios / adapter_runs; objects: comparison and its items, deliveries[*], rollback rejected / allowed and their scan, notes gate_decision (null allowed) and its snapshot, manifest.bundles); present with another type it is refused naming the file and the field, for produced and refused bundles alike, never read as empty (an object real_checks passed the dev16 shipped verifier); absent fields and empty lists stay valid; the same result before build (check_one_build) and through the shipped launcher.
